seo.title: Products — Eneon Technologies
seo.description: Eneon Technologies is building the engineering foundation for future proprietary hardware, software and connected products.

hero.title: From engineering solutions to *products.*
hero.lede: Eneon is building the technical capability and product discipline to create technology that stands on its own.

direction.title: A deliberate path, *not an empty promise.*
paragraphs: Our current focus is engineering solutions and prototypes for clients. Each engagement builds the practical knowledge needed for future proprietary hardware, software and connected products.
When a product is ready, it will be presented here with clear features, specifications, documentation, support information and an honest availability status.

catalogue.title: Where our products are *heading.*
catalogue.text: No commercial Eneon products have been announced yet. These are the areas our engineering work is building toward.

cta.title: Interested in what we are building?
